card.name: Punctuation after serious or fatal outcomes
card.fires_on: Commas, periods and "and" right after a listed serious medical event such as hemorrhage sites, heart failure, or "can be fatal". The setting is boxed-warning style text about death, stroke or bleeding.

modes.label: Comma in a list of serious events
modes.description: A comma or "and" inside a list of bleeding sites or causes of death.
modes.example: Fatal or serious cases of hemorrhage may occur, including gastrointestinal<<,>> pulmonary, and intracranial hemorrh

modes.label: Period after "can be fatal"
modes.description: The sentence-ending period right after a statement that events can be fatal.

card.writes: It seems to push toward starting the next item or sentence in a list of severe outcomes, and away from words like hospital, funeral or coffin.
card.plain: It fires on the comma or period that follows a named serious or fatal outcome in a warning list.
